li.label: humiliated by the council
li.description: They made an example of me while the others watched. I won't forget whose idea that was.

li.label: forgiven
li.description: I got it wrong, and they let it go. I owe them for that.

li.label: the council let it slide
li.description: One of us got off easy, and the council let it happen. It isn't fair on the rest of us.

li.label: the council was cruel
li.description: The council was far too hard on one of us. I didn't like watching it.

li.label: fair's fair
li.description: The council dealt with it properly, no favorites. Good.

li.label: the council took my side
li.description: I brought it to the council, and they agreed I was right.

li.label: the council took their side
li.description: I brought it to the council and they sided against me. Now I know where I stand.

li.label: won the council over against me
li.description: They went running to the council, and the council listened to them.

li.label: worked it out
li.description: We had it out and put it behind us. It's easier to be around them now.

li.label: stuck with someone I can't stand
li.description: Thrown together with them by the council's order. I can barely stand being near them.

li.label: the council wouldn't get involved
li.description: I asked for help and the council looked the other way.

li.label: a feast
li.description: We had a feast with the best food in the stores. I ate until I had to lie down.

li.label: a little feast
li.description: Not a banquet, but a good meal and a good evening.

li.label: no feast
li.description: I wanted to cook a proper feast for us all. The council said the stores come first.

li.label: they understood
li.description: I brought my trouble to the council, and they listened properly. I didn't expect that.

li.label: told to pull myself together
li.description: I admitted I was struggling. They told me to get back to work.

li.label: helped someone through a bad time
li.description: One of us was in a bad way, and I stayed with them through it.

li.label: was there for me
li.description: When things were bad, they stayed with me.

li.label: someone got days off
li.description: Days off for one of us, and the rest keep hauling. I'm tired too.

li.label: shared the stash
li.description: We found a forgotten stash and shared it out that night. It was a very good evening.

li.label: they locked up the good stuff
li.description: We found a whole stash, and the council locked it away to sell.

li.label: they poured it out
li.description: Perfectly good stuff, poured into the dirt on the council's orders. What a waste.

li.label: the poison is gone
li.description: That stash would only have caused trouble. Good riddance.
